title: Add consented coarse GPS telemetry
acceptance: Include fix age and accuracy; denied/stale fix unavailable; no lane/signal association.
evidence: ios/CoarseLocation: consent/authorization/foreground gate, rounded-only cache, original fix age and accuracy, <=1 Hz local context handoff, and Core Location adapter. 13 portable Swift tests passed with complete strict concurrency and warnings as errors using Swift 6.0.3 Linux.
decisions/CR-CS-019-location-context-contract.md proposes the required separate GPS contract; current accepted v1 protocol excludes GPS payloads. No network GPS publisher enabled.

2026-10-18 follow-up: 15 portable Swift tests passed; provider failure and reentrant recovery enforce new capture barriers. tests/ios/evidence/CS-019-recovery-20261018.json records source hashes and attributed earlier Apple build evidence from PR #69.

2026-10-18 sleep fix: LocationSystemClock uses ContinuousClock rather than awake uptime. 20 strict-concurrency Swift tests pass, including simulated sleep/recovery and real UTC-step rejection. tests/ios/evidence/CS-019-sleep-clock-20261018.json records exact tested source hashes; Apple/device and GPS transport acceptance remain pending.
blocker: Sleep-clock software fix prepared and portable tests pass. Completion still requires separately reviewed GPS wire contract/receiver and scope assignment, CS-016 host integration, current-head Apple build and real-device authorization/provider/sleep-resume verification. GPS network publishing remains disabled.
